about: Animated look (how-to card): opening of a Communication Clarity guide.

scenes.narration: Good feedback helps people see what they can't see themselves.
We all have blind spots. You can't hear how you sound in a meeting, or see how your text landed.
Done badly, feedback stings and gets ignored. Done well, it is one of the kindest things you can offer.
This guide covers how to give feedback that is specific, fair and timely, and how to praise so it counts.
And how to take feedback, ask for it, and act on it.
Think of one piece of feedback that genuinely helped you. Note what made it useful: who said it, how and when.
